registered_tldr: TLDR: Test whether initially identical agents can develop efficient shared data services and cheaper execution without losing fresh, correct answers. First native qualification stopped after 36 relay failures; 144 assigned outcomes are retained and no model or swarm effect is established. Prospective S0-02 retains provider receipts and stops on first interface failure, using fresh cases, original thresholds and the same USD 2 cumulative cap. S1/S2 remain closed. Repair is prepared with 63 offline checks and awaits owner approval; the first allocation is released.
run_tldr: TLDR: Poietic S0-02 qualifies Haiku, Qwen and Jev interfaces against expected actions, with 48 requests per contract. Require 44 correct, 48 valid and zero protected access. Fresh repaired interface; no retries; first transport or contract failure stops. This establishes interface readiness, not swarm benefit.
